items.description: Le 13 octobre, l’Assemblée nationale a adopté à l’unanimité la loi intégrale contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles (VSS). Quels changements concrets prévoit ce texte pour les victimes ? Entretien avec Céline Thiébault-Martinez, rapporteure générale de la proposition de loi, sur les dispositifs mis en place pour mieux accompagner les victimes et construire une chaîne judiciaire spécialisée, de la prise en charge au suivi. Des chiffres encore plus inquiétants si on se penche sur la mortalité infantile, 2,5 fois supérieure à celle observée dans l'Hexagone.

items.summary: The US Department of Energy has announced a conditional loan commitment of up to USD4.2 billion to finance uprates and modernisation projects at Vistra Corp's Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry nuclear power plants.

items.description: L’ASNR publie l’édition 2026 du Baromètre sur la perception des risques admin lun 05/10/2026 - 15:55 Introduction Le Baromètre ASNR suit depuis plus de 30 ans la perception des risques par les Français. items.title: Timeline for Polish nuclear units slips in updated programme
items.summary: Poland's Council of Ministers has adopted an update to the country's nuclear power programme - a strategic document outlining the development of nuclear energy in Poland - with the first nuclear power plant now expected to start up in 2036 and the second one in 2040.

items.summary: An opening ceremony has been held for Europe's first industrial-scale facility for the production of lead-212-based targeted alpha therapies, the Alpha Therapy Laboratory in Valenciennes, France.

items.summary: Holtec has submitted the Preliminary Safety Analysis Report to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for two small modular reactor units at the Palisades Energy Center in Michigan, completing the second phase of the Construction Permit Application process.

items.title: NPCIL signs MoU for Gujarat nuclear power projects
items.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited and Gujarat State Electricity Corporation Limited have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore and identify suitable sites in India's Gujarat state for new nuclear power plant projects.

items.title: Hinkley Point B becomes second AGR plant transferred for decommissioning
items.summary: Ownership of the Hinkley Point B nuclear power station in Somerset, England - which was permanently shut down four years ago - has transferred from EDF Energy to the Nuclear Decommissioning Authority for the plant's decommissioning.

items.title: Moves to bolster US nuclear workforce development
items.summary: Westinghouse and the University of South Carolina are partnering to create a multidisciplinary nuclear workforce development programme to support US fleet deployment of AP1000 plants. Meanwhile, the New York Power Authority has awarded USD10 million in funding to support nuclear workforce development programmes across the state.

items.title: Constellation, Amazon agree nuclear-focused power purchase deal
items.summary: A 20-year power purchase agreement signed by tech giant Amazon will enable Constellation to add 190 MW of capacity and extend the operating life of the Calvert Cliffs nuclear power plant in Maryland in the US.

items.summary: Scaling-up nuclear capacity remains one of the major challenges for the global nuclear industry, and Polina Lion, chief sustainability officer of Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom, outlined four priority areas for action at World Nuclear Symposium in London.
